widgets_values:
MiniMax H3｜24GB 通用稳定高质量版 + SeedVR2 1080

用途：
通用参考图生视频工作流。默认只启用 Picture 1；Picture 2-6 均可按镜头需要启用。
不预设人物类型、题材、画风、场景或剧情。

H3 主链：
• Full Ref2VA INT8
• Qwen3VL INT8
• Memory Efficient Sage
• Turbo LoRA 0.7
• 1.0MP / 16:9
• ref_image_size = max
• Euler + beta / 11 steps / denoise 1.0
• H3 seed 默认 randomize；需要复现时可改 fixed

SeedVR2 高清恢复：
• 7B FP16
• BlockSwap32
• IO Swap ON
• CPU Offload
• VAE Encode/Decode Tile768 / Overlap128
• 1080 short side / max1920
• Batch21
• LAB
• temporal_overlap = 3
• 24fps / H.264 MP4 / CRF17

使用：
1. Picture 1 放主参考。
2. 需要更多人物、场景、道具或补充参考时，再启用 Picture 2-6。
3. Prompt 中只定义本次真正启用的 Picture / Subject，避免无关参考污染。
4. 视频时长可直接调整。
5. 工作流内不包含任何项目专属角色、剧情、素材路径或示例资产。

widgets_values:
subject_definitions

<Subject 1>
The female lead from Picture 1.

Preserve her exact facial identity, hairstyle, facial proportions, skin tone, clothing style and age throughout the entire video.

She is a Korean-drama-style East Asian woman in her mid-to-late twenties.

Her appearance is naturally attractive, refined and realistic rather than cosmetically perfect.

Her skin must look like real live-action skin:
fine visible pores,
subtle natural texture,
slight natural variation in skin tone,
soft subsurface light transmission,
natural warm blood tone around the cheeks, nose wings and eyelids.

Her face must never become waxy, plastic, overly smooth or beauty-filtered.

Her eyes have realistic transparent corneal reflections, moist tear-film highlights, detailed dark-brown irises and naturally warm off-white sclera.

The female lead is the visual center of the entire scene.


<Subject 2>
An adult Korean man seated opposite the female lead.

His face must never be visible.

Only show his softly blurred shoulder and back, partial side-back head, dark jacket, or one hand near the table.

He remains visually secondary.


<Subject 3>
The café environment from Picture 2.

A realistic Korean-drama-style café beside a large window, warm-neutral natural daylight, wooden table for two, soft urban street activity visible outside the window.

Pedestrians may pass outside in soft background blur.

Maintain the same table, window, chairs and daylight direction throughout the entire scene.


summary

A 15-second realistic Korean drama scene with a subtle supernatural suspense hook.

The female lead arrives at a café expecting a romantic private meeting.

Before the male lead speaks, her phone receives a mysterious notification predicting exactly what he is about to say.

She initially finds the message strange and unbelievable.

Seconds later the male lead calmly tells her that he is getting married.

The camera then stays with the female lead long enough to capture expectation turning into disbelief, emotional pain, restraint, and quiet acceptance.

At the end she softly congratulates him.

After her final line, the phone vibrates once more off-screen while the camera remains on her face, creating a final unresolved hook.


retention_analysis

Preserve the female lead's exact identity throughout every emotional transition.

Her face remains clearly visible and large enough for facial detail during most of the video.

Do not redesign her face when she becomes emotional.

Maintain realistic skin translucency, facial texture and moist optical detail in the eyes.

The male lead must remain faceless throughout.

Keep the café spatial relationship consistent across the shot-reverse-shot structure.

The emotional reaction after the male lead speaks must receive a long uninterrupted close-up.

The final shot must end on the female lead's face.

Do not make her turn her head away before the video ends.


detailed_description

0.0-3.0 seconds:

Medium-close shot of the female lead seated beside the café window.

The opposite chair is partially visible.

Soft warm-neutral daylight falls naturally across her face.

She clearly believes this private meeting may be romantic.

Her eyes are bright.

A small involuntary smile appears.

She briefly glances toward the café entrance, then back toward the table.

Her fingers lightly touch the edge of her coffee cup.

She subtly smooths one loose strand of hair near her ear.

Her expression shows restrained anticipation rather than obvious excitement.

The camera performs a very subtle slow push toward her.


3.0-4.6 seconds:

Her smartphone on the table vibrates once.

Cut briefly to a close insert of her hand and the phone.

The screen lights up with a simple notification interface from an unknown sender.

Do not attempt to render readable text.

The exact message will be added in post-production.

She picks up the phone and reads.

Cut immediately back to her face.

Her eyebrows shift very slightly.

The hopeful expression becomes puzzled.

She does not look frightened.

She simply finds the message strange and unbelievable.


4.6-5.8 seconds:

Hard cut to a reverse angle.

The male lead is now seated opposite her.

Show only his dark shoulder, partial side-back head and one hand near the table.

His face stays completely outside the frame.

He speaks calmly, almost casually.

<Subject 2> (S2):
<d>[Korean]나 결혼해.</d>

Immediately hard cut back to the female lead.


5.8-11.8 seconds:

Hold one uninterrupted close-up on the female lead.

Do not cut away.

At first, she remains still.

For a brief half-second she seems to be comparing what she just heard with the message she read.

Then realization reaches her.

The small hopeful smile disappears.

Her eyes become still.

Her face briefly goes blank.

Her gaze lowers slightly.

Her breathing becomes shallow.

She makes one small involuntary inhale.

Her lips press together gently.

Moisture gradually gathers in her eyes.

The lower eyelids and nose area develop very subtle natural redness.

Do not make a tear fall.

Do not make her cry dramatically.

Allow several seconds for restrained hurt to remain visible on her face.

After holding the emotion, she slowly exhales.

Her shoulders loosen very slightly.

She raises her eyes toward the male lead again.

The sadness remains, but the earlier expectation is gone.

Her expression gradually becomes calm and accepting.


11.8-14.3 seconds:

Remain on the female lead in close-up.

The camera makes an almost imperceptible slow push closer.

She looks toward the male lead.

A short pause.

<Subject 1> (S1):
<d>[Korean]그럼… 축하해.</d>

The pause after “그럼” feels emotionally difficult but controlled.

Her voice is soft and restrained.

She does not smile broadly.

Her eyes remain slightly moist.

Only the faintest polite smile appears.

She has accepted the reality without fully recovering from the hurt.


14.3-15.0 seconds:

Hold completely on the female lead's face.

She does not turn her head.

She does not look toward the window.

She remains still.

The smartphone vibrates once again somewhere on the table, just outside the main focus.

Her eyes flick downward very slightly without moving her head.

A tiny trace of unease returns to her expression.

Cut immediately.

End on her face before she checks the phone.


overall_soundscape

Natural quiet café ambience.

Soft room tone, subtle ceramic contact, faint chair movement, gentle street ambience outside the window and occasional distant pedestrians.

The phone vibration at 3.0 seconds is clearly audible but realistic.

Immediately after the male lead says “나 결혼해.”, reduce the café ambience slightly for a brief emotional vacuum.

During the female lead's long reaction, her breathing becomes subtly more noticeable.

At the very end, the second phone vibration should be clean and distinct.

Keep dialogue intimate and realistic.


non_diegetic_music

No music during the opening expectation.

No music during the mysterious phone notification.

After the male lead says “나 결혼해.”, an extremely subtle restrained Korean-drama emotional texture may slowly enter.

Keep it minimal.

No swelling strings.
No melodramatic piano.

After “그럼… 축하해.”, reduce the music again.

The final phone vibration should land almost alone against the quiet café ambience.
